uncited: **Construct Calibration Set:** Select a set of scenes (plants) that are completely disjoint from the training set.

*   **Time Complexity:** Calibration requires a single forward pass over the calibration set to compute scores, followed by sorting $O(n_{cal} \log n_{cal})$.
Test-time inference adds a constant-time adjustment to the prediction interval.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Requires storing the calibration set and the sorted scores.
Memory usage is linear in the number of calibration rays.
*   **Measured Performance:** Evaluated on Pheno4D, ROSE-X, and UA-Field datasets.
At sparsity level $N=30$, UA-PlantNeRF with conformal calibration achieved PSNR $28.7 \pm 0.6$ dB and SSIM $0.89 \pm 0.01$, outperforming baselines ($p < 0.05$).
*   **Strengths:** Provides distribution-free, provable coverage guarantees; simple to implement as a post-processing step; improves reliability of uncertainty estimates.
*   **Limitations:** Only guarantees marginal coverage; requires a sufficiently large, exchangeable calibration set; does not provide per-region conditional guarantees.
